solid.block_header_format: each stored block begins with one marker byte, then a three-byte ASCII magic, then a u16 version. Observed magics: MSH, ANM, TEX.
solid.uncompressed_marker: a block whose first two bytes are C0 FF carries a 0xFFFFFFC0 length field and stores payload uncompressed
solid.block_fields: entry triples read as {u32 offset, u32 stored_size, u32 unpacked_size}; multiple entries share the 0x40000 (262144) unpacked size, which is the block granularity

contradiction.fact: if the entry table were a file table in name order, its magic distribution would mirror the name extension counts
contradiction.measured: entries by magic are roughly 1189 ANM, 572 TEX, 86 MSH, 111 raw and many unrecognised, which does not mirror 1776/1053/512
contradiction.also: 3207 of 3341 positions mismatch when assuming name order
contradiction.conclusion: either the entry table is not a file table but a block table, or the assumed table start 462045594 is wrong and the reads are misaligned

not_established: the true start of the entry table
whether entries are blocks or files
the mapping between name index and entry index
